主要内容: On May 31, 2012, the International Bureau of the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) announced the termination of DISH Network Corporation's license for use of the 148 degree orbital location. The license, which had a carrying value of $68 million, will require a write-off in Q2 2012 due to the FCC's termination. DISH Network Corporation disclosed that it is evaluating whether to challenge the termination of its license for the 148 degree orbital location. The company previously disclosed this issue in its public filings, including in its 10-K and 10-Q reports.
